inherited_obstruction: PERMUTATION_EQUIVARIANT_RELAY_ATTENUATION_OBSTRUCTION remains valid inside each fixed CURRENT_INGRESS phase class
proof: For a phase class containing M source-tag lineages with identical current ingress and identical controller-visible local signature, the within-class permutation group S_M acts transitively.
A deterministic stationary equivariant rule must assign the same allowed action set to every lineage in that class; it cannot select a unique proper subset.
The Stage-J positive family sends the entire incoming phase class to the same terminal H_INV action. It never realizes M->k with 0<k<M.
The resident START tag is relationally distinguishable from the incoming phase class. It may therefore either HOLD or launch a successor without lineage identity leakage.
Different ingress classes H,V,V_INV are already distinct current relational states, so a controller may treat entire classes differently without breaking within-class permutation symmetry.

single_signature_binary_obstruction.scope: homogeneous one-resident deterministic causal-support relay quotient; no claim beyond this frozen grammar
single_signature_binary_obstruction.statement: If every successful recruitment recreates exactly the same controller-visible relay signature rho and there is no evolving current count/vector state, then a stationary parameter value that transmits on rho transmits again forever on homogeneous sites, while a value that does not transmit stops at the first collision. Such a quotient cannot itself produce two different finite localized depths.
